facts.business: Sabrimala Industries India Limited has ventured into acquisition of stressed companies under CIRP and filed expression of interest and resolution plans, while its plastic goods manufacturing/trading activity remains inactive due to unfavorable market conditions.
key_risks: Unfavorable market conditions leading to no trading activity
Highly competitive and process-driven stressed asset resolution space
Rising input costs and subdued consumer sentiment in plastic goods industry
Dependence on interest income from inter-corporate deposits
facts.related_party_note: Interest income recognized on inter-corporate deposits given by the Company; accuracy depends on agreed terms with parties.
